select * from (SELECT '开放计划' planType, A.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID, A.VDATE AS VDATE, A.MDATE AS mdate,/*产品到期日*/ A.PROFIT_TYPE AS PROFIT_TYPE, E.OPEN_MDATE AS OPEN_MDATE, E.CASH_ID AS CASH_ID, E.OPEN_TYPE AS OPEN_TYPE, decode(F.Calc_Rule,'01',E.OPEN_CDATE,'02',E.OPEN_VDATE,'03',E.OPEN_MDATE) AS OPEN_VDATE, A.CALENDAR_ID AS CALENDAR_ID, D.PUR_SPEED AS PUR_SPEED, D.IS_CYCLE AS IS_CYCLE, D.CLOSE_DAYS AS CLOSE_DAYS, D.DEAL_MODE AS DEAL_MODE, F.OPEN_DAYS_TYPE AS OPEN_DAYS_TYPE, F.OPEN_DAYS AS OPEN_DAYS, F.OPEN_MODE AS OPEN_MODE, F.OPEN_CYCLE AS OPEN_CYCLE, F.OPEN_CYCLE_UNIT AS OPEN_CYCLE_UNIT, F.DAY_TYPE AS DAY_TYPE, F.DAY_VALUE AS DAY_VALUE, F.CALC_METHOD AS CALC_METHOD, F.FIRST_OPEN_DATE AS FIRST_OPEN_DATE, F.TRADEDAY_RULE AS TRADEDAY_RULE, F.HDAY_OPEN_FLAG AS HDAY_OPEN_FLAG, F.CALC_RULE AS CALC_RULE, F.CPRICE_RULE AS CPRICE_RULE, F.CREATE_USER AS CREATE_USER, F.CREATE_DEPT AS CREATE_DEPT, F.CREATE_TIME AS CREATE_TIME, F.UPDATE_USER AS UPDATE_USER, F.UPDATE_TIME AS UPDATE_TIME, G.Pur_Speed AS purConfDays, fcpr.PAY_CYCLE payCycleV FROM FIN_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN (SELECT T.CASH_ID, T.OPEN_TYPE, T.OPEN_DATE_END, T.OPEN_CDATE, T.OPEN_VDATE, T.OPEN_MDATE, T.FINPROD_ID, T.RN FROM (SELECT B.CASH_ID AS CASH_ID, C.OPEN_TYPE AS OPEN_TYPE, C.OPEN_DATE_END AS OPEN_DATE_END, C.Open_Vdate AS OPEN_CDATE, C.open_date_str AS OPEN_VDATE, C.open_date_end AS OPEN_MDATE, C.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID, RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY B.CASH_ID,C.OPEN_TYPE ORDER BY C.OPEN_VDATE DESC) RN FROM FIN_CASH_INFO B INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_PLAN C ON B.CASH_ID = C.CASH_ID WHERE B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashFinprodType} AND B.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType1} AND B.BRANCH = 0 ) T WHERE T.RN = 1 AND T.OPEN_VDATE between TRUNC(to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'),'mm') and trunc(add_months(to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'),1),'mm')-1 ) E ON A.FINPROD_ID = E.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD D ON A.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND D.ISSUE_STATUS = #{issueStatus} INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_RULE F ON E.CASH_ID = F.CASH_ID AND E.OPEN_TYPE = F.OPEN_TYPE INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD G ON A.FINPROD_ID = G.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fci.FINPROD_ID = E.FINPROD_ID and fci.CASH_TYPE_1 = '02' LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE fcpr on fcpr.CASH_ID = fci.CASH_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType} AND A.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL
AND A.OPERATION_TYPE = #{operationType} )b LEFT JOIN (select f.FINPROD_ID,di.institution_code from fin_product f left join DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST di on f.finprod_id=di.business_id and di.model_type = '02' and DI.DATA_TYPE='FINPROD04') di on di.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID where di.institution_code in (select si.INSTITUTION_CODE from sys_user su inner join SYS_DEPARTMENT sd on su.DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPT_CODE inner join SYS_INSTITUTION si on si.INSTITUTION_CODE = sd.INSTITUTION_CODE where su.USER_Name = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

select * from( SELECT '付息计划' planType,/*计划类型*/ fp.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId,/*金融产品代码*/ fp.PROFIT_TYPE AS profitType,/*收益类型*/ fp.VDATE AS vdate,/*产品起息日*/ fp.MDATE AS mdate,/*产品到期日*/ fp.CALENDAR_ID AS calendarId, /*交易日历*/ E.CASH_ID AS cashId, /*现金流代码*/ E.VDATE payVdate,/*付息计划区间开始日*/ E.CASH_NUM cashNum,/*现金流序号*/ E.MDATE payFPMdate,/*付息计划首次结束日*/ nvl2(fcpr.PAY_CYCLE_VAL,'02',fcpr.PAY_CYCLE) payCycle,/*支付频率:01到期 02周期支付*/ fcpr.PAY_CYCLE_VAL payCycleVal,/*支付频率值*/ nvl2(fcpr.PAY_CYCLE_VAL,fcpr.PAY_CYCLE,null) payCycleUnit,/*付息周期单位*/ fcpr.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule,/*支付日营业日准则*/ fcpr.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule,/*截止日营业日准则*/ fcpr.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDate,/*首次支付日*/ fcpr.CALC_RULE calcRule,/*推算方式*/ fp.LIQUIDATION_DATE winupDate/*清盘日*/ from FIN_PRODUCT fp INNER JOIN (SELECT T.CASH_ID, T.CASH_NUM, T.VDATE, T.MDATE, T.FINPROD_ID, T.RN FROM (SELECT B.CASH_ID AS CASH_ID, C.CASH_NUM AS CASH_NUM, C.VDATE AS VDATE, C.MDATE AS MDATE, C.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID, RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY B.CASH_ID ORDER BY C.VDATE DESC) RN FROM FIN_CASH_INFO B INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN C ON B.CASH_ID = C.CASH_ID WHERE B.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} AND B.BRANCH = 0 ) T WHERE T.RN = 1 AND T.VDATE between TRUNC(to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'),'mm') and trunc(add_months(to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'),1),'mm')-1 ) E ON fp.FINPROD_ID = E.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE fcpr ON E.CASH_ID = fcpr.CASH_ID AND fp.VDATE = fcpr.EFF_DATE where fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' AND fp.PROFIT_TYPE in ('02','03') AND fp.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL )b LEFT JOIN (select f.FINPROD_ID,di.institution_code from fin_product f left join DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST di on f.finprod_id=di.business_id and di.model_type = '02' and DI.DATA_TYPE='FINPROD04') di on di.FINPROD_ID = b.finprodId where di.institution_code in (select si.INSTITUTION_CODE from sys_user su inner join SYS_DEPARTMENT sd on su.DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPT_CODE inner join SYS_INSTITUTION si on si.INSTITUTION_CODE = sd.INSTITUTION_CODE where su.USER_Name = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

select TT.listN from ( select decode(t1.PROFIT_TYPE,'01',t.OPEN_NDATE,'03',t.OPEN_DATE_END) as listN from FIN_OPEN_PLAN t left join FIN_PRODUCT t1 on t1.FINPROD_ID=t.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_OPEN_RULE t2 on t2.CASH_ID=t.CASH_ID where t1.PROFIT_TYPE in('01','03') and t2.OPEN_MODE !='02' /*非高频开放*/ and t.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} )TT order by TT.listN
select CASH_ID from FIN_CASH_INFO where FINPROD_ID = #{FINPROD_ID,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C11' and BRANCH = 0

select DISTINCT t1.cash_id as cashId,t.vdate,t.mdate, t2.F_ACCR_DATE as provisionfirstday,t2.E_ACCR_DATE as eAccrDate from FIN_PRODUCT t left join FIN_CASH_INFO t1 on t1.finprod_id=t.finprod_id and t1.CASH_TYPE_2='C04' and t1.BRANCH = 0 left join FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE t2 on t2.cash_id=t1.cash_id where t.finprod_id=#{finprodId}

select DISTINCT t1.cash_id as cashId,t.vdate,t.mdate, t2.F_ACCR_DATE as firstAnapleroticDate,t2.E_ACCR_DATE as anapleroticEndDate, d.Accr_Str_Date firstAnapleroticCycleBegDate from FIN_PRODUCT t left join FIN_CASH_INFO t1 on t1.finprod_id=t.finprod_id and t1.CASH_TYPE_2='C11' and t1.BRANCH = 0 left join FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE t2 on t2.cash_id=t1.cash_id left join (select sc.CASH_ID,min(sc.Accr_Str_Date) Accr_Str_Date from FIN_FLOAT_ACCRUAL_SCHE sc group by sc.CASH_ID) d on t1.cash_id = d.cash_id where t.finprod_id=#{finprodId}

select t.mdate from ( SELECT decode(ps,'C7',mdate,'C9',trade_date) mdate, finprod_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY finprod_id ORDER BY decode(ps,'C7',mdate,'C9',trade_date) DESC ) ro FROM trd_fin_product_deal_total WHERE ps in ('C7','C9') AND finprod_type2 = 'F16' AND trade_status = '01' AND (is_cancel = 'N' OR is_cancel IS NULL) and finprod_id = #{finprodId} ) t where t.ro = 1

select A.VDATE AS openVdateUn,/*产品起息日*/ B.OPEN_DATE_STR AS openDateStr, B.OPEN_DATE_END AS openDateEnd, C.CASH_ID AS cashId, B.OPEN_VDATE AS openVdate from FIN_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_PLAN B ON B.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND B.OPEN_TYPE != '02' LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN C ON C.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND C.CASH_TYPE = '01' WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
